entries.zh: 冤愆；冤孽罪过（西语 agraviar pecar，损害、犯罪）
entries.en: injustice done, sin or fault committed

entries.zh: 乘机（仗势欺凌他人，agraviar fiado en otro）
entries.en: to take advantage on the credit of another, wrong someone relying on another's power
to exploit an opening to wrong another
tyranny, oppression with ill intent

entries.zh: 暴戾；恶待他人（q.v. oprimir，压虐）
entries.en: cruel and violent treatment, to mistreat
sour
sour and astringent, unripe

entries.zh: 崎（路险难行，上下坡险峻）
entries.en: steep, rugged (of a way up or down)
a steep descent

entries.zh: 崎难上（如沿墙上行的难路，闽音白读「手」与汉栏「上」互异，存疑）
entries.en: a way hard to ascend, as climbing along a wall
entries.notes: M 栏 chiú（手/手音写）与 H 栏「上」不合，按汉栏与 R 栏取「难上」义。

entries.zh: 崎成壁（陡立如墙的坡路）
entries.en: steep as a wall, an ascent like along a wall
agriculture, husbandry
agriculture or its instruments, farm implements

entries.zh: 水；水类（M 栏 tug. 疑为「水类/水名」类注缩写）
entries.en: water; water as a category
entries.notes: M 栏 tug. 为缩略类注，展开依赖推断，降为 medium。

entries.en: deep water, abyss
deep water like the sea
impounded water, a channel or pool

entries.zh: 海上恶水（H 栏「蚱」疑为「礁」类字之原稿形，M 音 thê 近「𪹚/滩」读，释义存疑）
entries.en: bad waters of the sea (the character reading is uncertain)
entries.notes: H 栏字形与四栏互证不足，「蚱」义与西栏 aguas malas del mar 不合，存疑。

entries.zh: 恶水之蒲（M 音 phôu，或指恶水浮沫/苦蒲水域，语义存疑）
entries.en: bad sea waters: froth or reed-bed of the evil waters (uncertain)
entries.notes: 承 position 18 字形疑点；蒲字与西栏关系不明，存疑。

entries.zh: 恶水之盘（恶水盘绕之处）
entries.en: bad sea waters: the stretch where they coil
entries.notes: 承 position 18 字形疑点，按「盘」字义补释义，降为 medium。

entries.en: bad sea waters, the water itself
entries.notes: 承 position 18 字形疑点，水字四栏互证清晰。
